cell_line.evidence: Mitochondria-enriched fractions were prepared from HEK293T CYTB-KD, ND2-KD (treated for CYTB and ND2 gene silencing for 48 hours) and control cells (4 independent replicates each) as follows: HEK293T cell pellets were resuspended in THE buffer (10 mM HEPES/KOH, 300 mM Trehalose, 10 mM KCl, 1 mM EGTA, pH 7.4) supplemented with 1% BSA and 1 mM PMSF, and incubated for 10 min on ice.
